_campaign.name: DUSP1/MKP-1 active-site inhibitor (sister to DUSP6; extends phosphatase panel; SMA MAPK survival axis)

_pocket.source_title_verified: ALPHAFOLD MONOMER V2.0 PREDICTION FOR DUAL SPECIFICITY PROTEIN PHOSPHATASE 1 (P28562)

_rationale.sma_link: DUSP1 inactivates ERK/JNK/p38 MAPKs. Inhibition sustains multi-MAPK pro-survival signalling in SMA motor neurons (broader than DUSP6 which is ERK-selective).
_rationale.selectivity_panel: Top 100 → Boltz-2 vs DUSP1 + DUSP6 + SSH1 + SSH2 + SSH3 phosphatase panel; DUSP1-selective if z_DUSP1 > 0 AND z_DUSP1 > z_DUSP6.
